summary: Story decomposition is sound and consistent with the accepted WI-03a/WI-03b tier-batch standard: two leaves, each a strict subset of the parent's 3 changed subsystems, each one focused behavior, no per-organism split (both leaves cover the full 4-6-organism tier-3 batch). WI-03c1a (foundation; world content data, creature simulation): the 4-6 tier-3 CreatureDefs in production content (hiddenCreatures.ts) plus the section 10 damage model per size class, landing the large-predator deterable-not-killable behavior as the data/behavior basis of the 4+ non-pursuit floor. WI-03c1b (depends on WI-03c1a; creature simulation, headless scenario tests): per-predator controllers (bespoke to ~120 lines per section 19, or the generic ST-02 state machine plus rules) with the non-chase hunting strategy as a specific controller instance, one headless trigger-plus-control scenario per predator, and the FINAL PROOF headless roster check for AC-roster-behavior - the scenarios and the cross-tier roster check being the leaf's tests/evidence, not separate behaviors (matches the already-accepted WI-03c1b leaf receipt and the prior WI-03c1 split recommendation that put the final proof in WI-03c1b). Dependencies correct: WI-03c1b depends on WI-03c1a (controllers extend the defs and damage model; scenarios exercise the controllers); no in-story ancestor/descendant edges; the story inherits WI-03b through parent WI-03c (depends_on WI-03b) because the final proof counts the friendly species WI-03b1 lands, and inherits ST-01 (WI-01b) and ST-02 (WI-02a/b/c) through ST-03, gated on WI-02a/b/c acceptance; the parent's WI-03c2 -> WI-03c1 edge now means both leaves (spawns reference WI-03c1a defs; the browser spot-check exercises WI-03c1b controllers). Acceptance preserved: child criteria are verbatim parent text and their union covers both story criteria (AC-roster-behavior via both leaves; AC-roster-tests via WI-03c1b, with the roster-wide spoiler audit finalizing in WI-03d); the final AC-roster-behavior proof has a named owner (WI-03c1b) matching the WI-03c/ST-03 plan and runs after WI-03b lands. Handoffs are fresh-session ready: concrete file pointers (hiddenCreatures.ts, src/sim/scenario.ts), request sections 10/11.1/11.2/13/19/33/46/68/70/74, WI-01b organism ids, design_private/ as source of truth, the falsifiable ST-02 assumption (generalize if two predators need the same bespoke controller), the section 11.2 anti-cliche and section 46 hard gates, and spoiler-safe commit style.
